description: A shell script for testing Git merge scenarios related to file modes, permissions, and conflict detection.

methods.name: do_one_mode
methods.description: Performs a merge with a specified strategy between two branches and verifies the file mode (executable bit).

methods.name: do_both_modes
methods.description: Tests conflict detection when both branches change file modes.

methods.name: do_delete_modechange
methods.description: Checks conflicts when one branch deletes a file while another changes its mode.
